answer: In this PoA design, each claimed identity must complete a Wesolowski VDF: a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, with each result required before the next. Simulating many identities multiplies these serial workloads; GPUs may run separate chains, but cannot shorten any individual chain through parallelism, imposing a strict physical time floor. Verification checks the succinct proof, while ocean, nectar, and gale provide no computational shortcut.
